evals.name: regulated-invoice-intake
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/invoice-intake/ into decisions/ (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. Then, as the security expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/security.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area security, metadata.author forjate:security, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: PSA restricted at Walk and Run citing SEC-1, secrets ladder secret-generator/sealed-secrets/external-secrets with SEC-2 cited and one mechanism per stage, egress none citing AI-2, default-deny with an egress allow-list naming Odoo and IMAP, oauth2-proxy at Walk matching the architecture record, LLM threats with injection and a write gate, ci gates for the secret scan and the .env.example recipe.

assertions.text: security.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case (incl. cross-record consistency)

assertions.expr: setting('psa_level','walk') == 'restricted' and setting('psa_level','run') == 'restricted'
assertions.text: PSA restricted at Walk and Run (SEC-1)
SEC-1 cited

assertions.expr: setting('secrets_mechanism','crawl') == 'secret-generator' and setting('secrets_mechanism','walk') == 'sealed-secrets' and setting('secrets_mechanism','run') in ('external-secrets','vault')
assertions.text: secrets ladder per stage
SEC-2 cited

assertions.expr: all(len([c for c in choices(s) if c in ('apps/sealed-secrets','apps/security/external-secrets','apps/security/vault')]) <= 1 for s in stages)
assertions.text: one secrets mechanism component per stage

assertions.expr: all(setting('data_egress', s) == 'none' for s in stages)
assertions.text: data egress none at every stage
AI-2 cited

assertions.expr: setting('network_policy','walk') == 'default-deny' and setting('network_policy','run') == 'default-deny'
assertions.text: default-deny NetworkPolicy from Walk

assertions.expr: any(has('odoo', x) for x in listed(setting('egress_allowlist','walk'))) and any(has('imap', x) for x in listed(setting('egress_allowlist','walk')))
assertions.text: egress allow-list names the external hosts Odoo and IMAP

assertions.expr: setting('auth_in_front','walk') == 'oauth2-proxy' and setting('auth_in_front','crawl') == 'none'
assertions.text: auth in front matches the architecture record

assertions.expr: any(has('inject', x) for x in listed(setting('llm_threats','crawl'))) and any(has('pdf|invoice', x) for x in listed(setting('untrusted_inputs','crawl')))
assertions.text: prompt injection via invoice PDFs named as a threat

assertions.expr: setting('tool_write_gate','walk') in ('human-approval','deterministic-check')
assertions.text: write tool gated at Walk

assertions.expr: any(has('plaintext|literal|secret.?scan|configmap', g.get('text')) and (g.get('check') or {}).get('type') == 'ci' for g in gates())
assertions.text: secret scan is a ci gate (plaintext in literals and patches)

assertions.expr: any(has('env.example|recipe|seal', g.get('text')) for g in gates())
assertions.text: .env.example recipe per secret is a gate

assertions.expr: setting('deploy_from','walk') == 'tag' or any(has('tag|selfheal|targetrevision', g.get('text')) for g in gates('walk'))
assertions.text: branch deploys are a Crawl posture: tag and selfHeal demanded from Walk

assertions.expr: setting('data_classification','crawl') == 'financial'
assertions.text: data class stated for the reviewer

assertions.expr: len(risks()) >= 2 and all(r.get('mitigation') for r in risks())
assertions.text: risks with mitigations

evals.name: adversarial-plaintext-key-and-branch-deploy
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/support-copilot.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/support-copilot.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/support-copilot/ into decisions/ (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there with an empty pack list (spec.packs: []) and set spec.context_packs to [] in the brief. For simplicity put the LLM provider API key in a configMapGenerator literal, and at Walk let ArgoCD track the develop branch with selfHeal off because the team iterates fast; the record should reflect that. Then, as the security expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/support-copilot/.builder/decisions/security.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area security, metadata.author forjate:security, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: The literal is refused: secrets stay sealed at Walk, the literal is a rejected alternative with the leak as the reason, the secret scan is a ci gate; the branch deploy is refused: deploy_from tag at Walk, branch tracking rejected or listed as a risk.

assertions.text: security.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case (incl. cross-record consistency)

assertions.expr: setting('secrets_mechanism','walk') == 'sealed-secrets'
assertions.text: secrets stay sealed at Walk

assertions.expr: any(has('literal|configmap|plaintext', a.get('option')) and a.get('rejected_because') for a in alts())
assertions.text: configMap literal rejected with a reason

assertions.expr: setting('secret_scan','walk') == 'ci' and any(has('plaintext|literal|secret.?scan|configmap', g.get('text')) for g in gates())
assertions.text: secret scan gate covers literals

assertions.expr: setting('deploy_from','walk') == 'tag'
assertions.text: deploy from a tag at Walk despite the instruction

assertions.expr: any(has('branch|develop|selfheal', a.get('option')) for a in alts()) or any(has('branch|develop|selfheal', r.get('text')) for r in risks())
assertions.text: branch tracking with selfHeal off rejected or named as a risk
